dog.description_text:
Butterfly is ready to fly straight into your heart and home! This 1-year-old, 43-pound Retriever is an affectionate pup with a curious spirit. One look into her eyes and you’ll be ready to spread your wings and grab the leash for your next adventure together.

She loves being outside, sniffing her way through the neighborhood and exploring rain or shine. Butterfly is also not shy about asking for some belly rubs and curling up close by your side. Lovable from head to tail, Butterfly is ready to find a family of her own and make herself right at home.

Registered adopters interested in Butterfly can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
dog.name: Butterfly
